newsitem.title: USA: Government Technology gets army contract.
newsitem.headline: Government Technology gets army contract.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc said Thursday that it and another company have won a U.S. Army contract worth up to $236.7 million.

Under the indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract, GTSI will provide commercial, off-the-shelf portable computers to the Army and other defense agencies over the next two years, the company said.
GTSI, a government reseller of microcomputer and Unix products, currently sells notebook computers to the Army under a contract that expires in January 1997.
